adjudication.rationale: The diff does introduce several fire-and-forget async calls in the members flow: both routes call `model.findMembers();` without returning/awaiting the promise (`admin_group_route.js` and `discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6`), and the admin controller’s `addMembers` action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(...)` without returning/handling the promise. In `removeMember`, the inner `self.get("model").removeMember(member);` promise is also ignored. Additionally, `findMembers/addMembers/removeMember` have only success `.then(...)` paths and no `.catch(...)`/error feedback. However, nothing in the diff proves this causes a definite broken behavior (Ember will still re-render when `members` is set on success), so it’s best classified as a robustness/UX/flow concern rather than a verifiable defect.
